text: A 39-byte HTTP request over TCP/IPv4/Ethernet produces a frame of what size?
explanation: 39 + 20 (TCP) = 59-byte segment; + 20 (IP) = 79-byte packet; + 14 (Ethernet header) + 4 (FCS) = 97-byte frame. Each layer treats the layer above as opaque payload, and the EtherType is the marker that lets the receiver undo it.
